detailed_description:
The target video uses a photorealistic live-action cinematic style with clean digital image and the same soft overcast daylight.
[Shot 1] Continue the actual medium-wide view of Lena south of Henrik's teal counter without restarting the handover. During the first two seconds everything continues exactly as in the preceding frames. Lena holds her purchased red apple near her chest in the same hand seen in the preceding footage. The ivory cloth is empty and Henrik watches her from behind his stall. Lena turns naturally toward the SOUTH entrance and walks across the open cobbles toward the same two ball-topped gateposts, carrying the apple. The camera smoothly backs away toward the southern entrance and cranes upward, tilting down as it rises, revealing progressively more of this SAME square in one continuous real-time move. First the west fountain and mustard-coated shopper and the east yellow stall and lilac shopper come back into view; then the west bench and burgundy reader, blue double door, southwest wooden handcart and southern gateposts become visible. The cream clock building remains on the north side behind Henrik's teal stall; the tree remains on the east side, north of the yellow stall. The camera ends in a high oblique establishing view from above the southern entrance, with the same market layout clearly recognizable. Lena is approaching the gate with the apple still hers; Henrik remains behind the counter whose ivory cloth stays empty. The three background shoppers continue their small existing activities in their respective original zones. One uninterrupted physical crane-out with continuous parallax, fixed focal length and naturally diminishing figure scale.

<Subject 4> become visible in their established fountain, bench and yellow-stall zones as the view widens.
